name: document-templates
description: Invoices and other documents from templates, fully local: a ready-made invoice or your own layout to PDF, fillable PDF forms and Word templates filled in, saved in tidy folders with running numbers

nodes.title: List templates
nodes.description: Lists the built-in templates and the template formats this plugin can fill, with the operation for each

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Describe a template
nodes.description: Shows what a template needs: for a layout template its fields, placeholders and sample values; for a Word template its {{placeholders}}; for a PDF its form fields (or that it has none)

template.description: Built-in template name (invoice), or a .json, .docx, .dotx or .pdf file inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_INPUT_DIRS

include_layout.description: For a layout template: also return its full layout, to save as a .json file and adapt

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Next document number
nodes.description: Issues the next running number for a pattern such as INV-{YYYY}-{SEQ:4} (INV-2026-0001, INV-2026-0002, ...). The count restarts when the pattern's date part changes. Counters are kept in DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_OUTPUT_DIR/.document-templates/numbering.json

pattern.description: Number pattern with one {SEQ} (or {SEQ:4} for four digits) and optional {YYYY} {YY} {MM} {DD} {ROMAN} (month as a Roman numeral), e.g. "{SEQ:3}/INV/{ROMAN}/{YYYY}"

date.description: Date the number is for, as YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)

start_at.description: First number of a counter that has not been used yet, e.g. 38 to continue after INV-2026-0037

preview.description: Only show the next number without reserving it

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create a PDF from a template
nodes.description: Creates a PDF from a layout template and values: the built-in `invoice`, or your own .json layout template. Totals are calculated for you, the table continues over pages, and the PDF is saved as <folder>/<file_name>.pdf (default 2026/11/INV-2026-0001.pdf). An existing file is never replaced unless a node asks

template.description: Built-in template name (invoice) or a .json layout template inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_INPUT_DIRS

values.description: The document's values as an object (or JSON text), e.g. {"number": "INV-2026-0001", "client": {"name": "PT Maju"}, "items": [...]}. describe_template lists what a template uses

values_file.description: Instead of `values`: a .json file with the values, inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_INPUT_DIRS

calculate.description: invoice: calculate line amounts, subtotal, discount, taxes and totals from `items` (exact decimals) and add them as `totals`; none: use the values as given; auto (default): a layout template decides (the built-in invoice calculates), a Word or PDF form template calculates when the values have `items`

background.description: A PDF inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_INPUT_DIRS drawn under every page, e.g. your letterhead (its page 1 under the first page, its page 2, if any, under the others)

folder.description: Folder inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_OUTPUT_DIR, as a pattern (default "{YYYY}/{MM}", the document's year and month). Tokens: {YYYY} {MM} {DD} (from the values' `date`, else today), {number}, {client}, {template}, and {values.some.field}. Example: "Invoices/{client}/{YYYY}"

file_name.description: File name without extension, as a pattern with the same tokens (default "{number}" when the values have a number, else "{template}-{YYYY}{MM}{DD}-{time}")

if_exists.description: When the file already exists: error (keep it and fail), number (save next to it as name-2, name-3, ...) or overwrite (replace it; workflow nodes only)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Fill in a PDF form
nodes.description: Fills the form fields of a fillable PDF (AcroForm) and saves the result as a new PDF. `fields` maps field names to values; a value may use {{placeholders}} from `values`, including calculated totals such as {{totals.total | money}}. A PDF without form fields (a scan, a picture, plain pages) cannot be filled: use render_pdf

fields.description: Form field names and their values, e.g. {"InvoiceNo": "{{number}}", "Total": "{{totals.total | money}}", "Paid": true}

fields_file.description: Instead of `fields`: a .json file with the field map, inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_INPUT_DIRS (reusable for every document from this form)

values.description: The document's values as an object (or JSON text), e.g. {"number": "INV-2026-0001", "client": {"name": "PT Maju"}, "items": [...]}. describe_template lists what a template uses

values_file.description: Instead of `values`: a .json file with the values, inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_INPUT_DIRS

calculate.description: invoice: calculate line amounts, subtotal, discount, taxes and totals from `items` (exact decimals) and add them as `totals`; none: use the values as given; auto (default): a layout template decides (the built-in invoice calculates), a Word or PDF form template calculates when the values have `items`

flatten.description: Turn the filled fields into plain page content so the result can no longer be edited (default true)

folder.description: Folder inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_OUTPUT_DIR, as a pattern (default "{YYYY}/{MM}", the document's year and month). Tokens: {YYYY} {MM} {DD} (from the values' `date`, else today), {number}, {client}, {template}, and {values.some.field}. Example: "Invoices/{client}/{YYYY}"

file_name.description: File name without extension, as a pattern with the same tokens (default "{number}" when the values have a number, else "{template}-{YYYY}{MM}{DD}-{time}")

if_exists.description: When the file already exists: error (keep it and fail), number (save next to it as name-2, name-3, ...) or overwrite (replace it; workflow nodes only)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Fill in a Word template
nodes.description: Fills the {{placeholders}} of a Word template (.docx or .dotx) and saves the result as a new .docx. A table row between {{#items}} and {{/items}} repeats for every item, and totals are calculated for you. The result is a Word file, not a PDF

values.description: The document's values as an object (or JSON text), e.g. {"number": "INV-2026-0001", "client": {"name": "PT Maju"}, "items": [...]}. describe_template lists what a template uses

values_file.description: Instead of `values`: a .json file with the values, inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_INPUT_DIRS

calculate.description: invoice: calculate line amounts, subtotal, discount, taxes and totals from `items` (exact decimals) and add them as `totals`; none: use the values as given; auto (default): a layout template decides (the built-in invoice calculates), a Word or PDF form template calculates when the values have `items`

folder.description: Folder inside DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_OUTPUT_DIR, as a pattern (default "{YYYY}/{MM}", the document's year and month). Tokens: {YYYY} {MM} {DD} (from the values' `date`, else today), {number}, {client}, {template}, and {values.some.field}. Example: "Invoices/{client}/{YYYY}"

file_name.description: File name without extension, as a pattern with the same tokens (default "{number}" when the values have a number, else "{template}-{YYYY}{MM}{DD}-{time}")

if_exists.description: When the file already exists: error (keep it and fail), number (save next to it as name-2, name-3, ...) or overwrite (replace it; workflow nodes only)

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
